description: Java source code for a simple Android ContentProvider named FileProvider, which serves asset files from an APK and handles file access and data transfer.

classes.name: FileProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider that serves asset files from the APK, supporting file querying and streaming.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Provides metadata about the file, such as display name and size.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts data; not supported, returns null.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns MIME type for files, here always 'application/vnd.android.package-archive'.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens an asset file as a ParcelFileDescriptor for reading.

methods.name: writeDataToPipe
methods.description: Transfers data from InputStream to the output pipe.
